nutrition_decision.headline: Fuel Your Work
nutrition_decision.subheading: Prepare the meals you tend to miss.
nutrition_decision.breakfast: 2 bread slices about 80 g, 32 g peanut butter, 1 medium navel orange, 1 labeled serving Thorne chocolate whey in 355 mL whole milk
nutrition_decision.before_run: 1 medium banana; tolerance check; not the full long-run fueling plan
nutrition_decision.afternoon: one quarter of the 454 g dry spaghetti + 454 g raw 93% lean beef + 680 g sauce batch
nutrition_decision.review: 7-day adherence/tolerance review, 2-week intake and mass trend; confirm actual start date
nutrition_decision.storage: shallow containers promptly refrigerated; freeze later portions; 40°F fridge; 160°F ground beef; 165°F leftovers
nutrition_decision.weekend_rule: Restaurant meals replace home meals, not duplicate them. Five workday pasta portions plus three frozen backups; review nugget label before setting that portion.

supplement.caveat: Use current container serving and confirm lot. Certification reduces, not eliminates, risk. Taste/tolerance and medical constraints not yet established.
